profile.headline: Web Developer at Air Force Civilian Service
profile.summary: SharePoint, Web Development, Knowledge Management, IT, and Cyber SME who exemplifies leadership, commitment and dedication to excellence.  Master’s in Computer Science who specializes in improving business operations using web and database integration to bring web pages to life.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Lead web developer for DoD organization, specializing in connecting data driven lists to custom coded web pages and user access forms, using JQuery, REST, HTML, JavaScript.

positions.title: Cyber Exercise Planner
positions.description:
- Develops exercise objectives and integrates into Combatant Command Tier 1 events to exercise JFHQ-DODIN's ability to command and direct action across the network in order to protect and defend the DODIN against malicious cyber activity. Provides technical direction and oversight for Joint Exercise Control Group activities, which fully simulate cyber operations actions and responses. Facilitates evaluation of both existing and experimental TTPs within the defensive cyberspace community during exercises.
- Provides web development support to the cyber exercise portals. 
- Custom data visualizations using SharePoint REST APIs, CSS, JavaScript Libraries and custom web parts. These solutions helped save JFHQ staff many hours of work by allowing them to view information real-time vs using dated spreadsheets and powerpoint slides. 
- User interface design, customization and application development using SharePoint Designer, CSS, HTML, jQuery, Bootstrap and other code libraries.

positions.title: SharePoint Engineer/Developer
positions.description:
- Web Developer/SharePoint engineer for JFHQ-DODIN managing all facets of SharePoint operations on unclassified and classified platforms.  Ground-up build for all the DODIN sites, incorporated security measures, master pages, common design, world clocks, dashboards on SharePoint 2010 and 2013 platforms.  Expertise called on by USCYBERCOM, USCENTCOM, ARL.
- Expert in process improvement utilizing JQuery, Javascripts, SharePoint Services, CAML, SharePoint lists, Infopath forms .  Creates advanced solutions for JFHQ-DODIN greatly improving their ability to develop, plan, coordinate and defend the DODIN.

positions.title: Sharepoint Consultant for JSEIO at DISA
positions.description:
- Responsible for designing Configuration Management (CM) tools and processes through SharePoint and other data automation tools for establishing an Enterprise CM plan for the National Leadership Command Capabilities (NLCC) systems with oversight from the DoD CIO and the Joint Systems Engineering Integration Office (JSEIO).  Assisting with stand-up of JSEIO office and building online presence for directorate and subordinate divisions.  

- Analyzing business process to determine which can be improved using inherent SharePoint capabilities through workflows, Lists, Shared Libraries and Task Assignments.  Streamlining Management oversight giving the Commander a snapshot view of the status of the organization allowing Leadership to quickly see the focus areas for the organization and visualize the successes.

positions.title: Joint Exercise Planner & IT Engineer
positions.description:
- Plans and manages execution of DoD level cyber exercises. Provides a cyber range environment for the command to train. Fuses the Department of Defense global cyber vision and realistic exercises and builds current and future cyber operators.

- Technical Lead for designing $3M cyber simulation system, incorporated a scaled down version of the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN) complete w/firewalls, routers, switches, proxy servers, CISCO VOIP, Call Manager, everything a normal base would have to include a classified and unclassified network.  Drafted the requirements, contacted possible bidders, wrote statement of work and ensured all bids met government specifications.

positions.title: Sharepoint Administrator & Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and built a file, sharepoint, backup and SQL server fielding for a major military headquarters in Afghanistan for 1000 users incorporating 4TBs of storage.  It was imperative that the design plan was right the first time because procurement usually took 3+months with ocean shipment and trucked to remote location.  After the equipment arrived in crates he brought them into the building and setup, cabled, labeled & calculated power/HVAC requirements for five racks of servers.

- Administered Share Point site collections for 50+ organizations.  Appointed an administrator for each section and trained them to manage their site.  Enforced group permissions and designed the master page with scrolling classification banner, four time zone clocks, organizational logo and name.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
- Led largest IT Flight in the Air Force with 250 personnel under command.  Delivered IT services for 24,000 users to include, web, mail, file, Sharepoint, Records Management, FOIA, Helpdesk and Telephones and Fiber Install/Repair for a base large enough equivalent to a city.

- Using his programming background and knowledge of databases, HTML, VB/Java Script, SQL queries he wrote an ASP notification system that provided the Commander of a stop light view of all major systems across the base, providing a real-time update of status changes to his blackberry device.

positions.title: Chief Range IT Manager
positions.description:
- Provided policy, operations, and IT sustainment guidance for the Command’s 14 air-to-ground ranges and 2 major range complexes valued at over $1.3B.

- Managed the Department of Defense Information Technology Security and Accreditation Process (DITSCAP)/Defense Information Assurance and Accreditation Process (DIACAP) certification process for 300 range assets whether stand-alone or connected to the internet.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
- Led team of 85 personnel that supported web, mail records and crypto operations for over 5,000 users to include, web, mail, file, Sharepoint, Records Management, COMSEC, IAO, FOIA, Helpdesk and Telephones and Fiber Install/Repair for a base large enough equivalent to a city.

- Wing Information Assurance Officer for the base as well as tenant units scattered across Turkey.  

- Using his HTML, web programming and database design knowledge he built a numerous web tracking tools that were instrumental in improving operations (HTML, SQL, VBScript & Java Script).  One tool incorporated a 500+ checklist differing for each unit into one dashboard view providing the commander a summarized status for the base

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
- Led team of nine software development engineers to digest Tera-bytes of raw radar data into a time-lapse graphical data representation for the Air Force’s premier Joint STARS radar aircraft.  

- Designed and built 50 person data center capable of housing servers, operators and a secure conference area praised by senior leaders for excellence and vast improvement for operations.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description: - Oversaw team of five that supported a 250-person headquarters supplying web, file and mail services to the Headquarters team.

educations.schoolName: U.S. Air Force Institute of Technology
